overviewHelp: How often each domain appears in AI answers
hostOverviewHelp: How often each host appears in AI answers
weekNote: Each point is the total retrievals for that week, starting on Monday.
monthNote: Each point is the total retrievals for that month.
filterChartNote: The filters above also apply to this chart. Reset them to see every line.
chartEmpty: No line matches these filters. Reset filters to see the chart again.
moversHelp: How often each domain and domain type is retrieved
hostMoversHelp: How often each host is retrieved
topTip: Domains with the highest number of retrievals in the selected timeframe
newTip: Domains retrieved for the first time in the selected timeframe
trendingTip: Domains showing the fastest growth in retrieval activity
losingTip: Domains showing the largest decline in retrieval activity
topHostTip: Hosts with the highest number of retrievals in the selected timeframe
newHostTip: Hosts retrieved for the first time in the selected timeframe
trendingHostTip: Hosts showing the fastest growth in retrieval activity
losingHostTip: Hosts showing the largest decline in retrieval activity
moversEmpty: Nothing is {tab} in this preview. Open Top to see the busiest rows.
noTopSources: No source of this type is in the current filters.
domainsHelp: Detailed breakdown of domain visibility across AI responses
hostsHelp: Detailed breakdown of host visibility across AI responses
gapOn: Gap analysis is on. The list shows domains that mention at least the chosen number of competitors.
gapOff: Gap analysis is off. The list includes domains even when no competitor is mentioned.
noBrandMatch: No brand matches that search. Try another name.
exportEmptyBody: The list is empty. Clear the search or loosen the filters, then export again.
mentionsTip: Brands mentioned on this domain. Hover a mark to see the brand name.
noSearchBody: Clear the search or try a different word.
noFilterBody: Reset the list filters. The page filters above are separate.
selectPage: Select all rows on this list
showingAll: Showing all {count} rows in this preview.
showingFiltered: Showing {count} rows. Reset list filters to see the full set.
missingTitle: This domain is not in the preview
missingBody: Open Domains and choose a row from the list.
domainTypeHelp: How this site is classified in the preview.
retrievalsHelp: No. of times AI retrieves this domain
usedHelp: Share of answers that use this domain as a source
citedHelp: Share of answers that cite this domain
retrievalRateHelp: Retrievals divided by the answers in this preview
citationRateHelp: Citations divided by the answers in this preview
urlMoversHelp: How often each URL and URL type is retrieved
pagesHelp: Every page AI used for {brand} on this domain
noPages: No pages are stored for this domain.
noPagesBody: Open another domain from the list.
copiedBody: {count} chat titles are on the clipboard.
noChats: No chats match these filters. Clear a filter to see them again.
dateMissing: No date was saved for this answer. Refresh the page after the run finishes.
daysAgo: {count, plural, =0 {today} =1 {1 day ago} other {# days ago}}
noTagsYet: No tags yet. Create tags on the Prompts page, then add them here.
